S1.name: 旗手之擊
S1.description: 用旗幟攻擊敵人，有75%的機率使其沉默1回合。如果攻擊後敵人處於沉默狀態，將降低其戰鬥準備度25%。

S2.name: 鎖定目標
S2.description: 解除單一敵人的所有增益效果後，有100%的機率使其獲得目標狀態2回合，且除施法者外的所有隊友將使用基本技能攻擊該敵人。增加施法者30%的戰鬥準備度。

S3.name: 勝利之旗
S3.description: 解除所有敵人的2個增益效果，然後有100%的機率使其獲得恐懼狀態2回合並降低戰鬥準備度20%。給予所有隊友速度提升2回合。在第一場戰鬥開始時，給予施法者閃避提升2回合。

S1.name: 死神之鐮
S1.description: 使用西格爾德之鐮攻擊敵人，並將施法者的戰鬥準備度提高20%。在施法者回合使用時，會發動終極解放作為額外攻擊。終極解放：攻擊所有敵人，並給予施法者1回合隱身，同時減少技能冷卻時間2回合。

S2.name: 死亡統治
S2.description: 敵方英雄無法復活，也無法獲得不死。攻擊時，穿透目標85%的防禦力，且無法觸發暴擊或重擊。

S3.name: 無法逃脫的死亡
S3.description: 給予施法者3回合攻擊力提升後，釋放冥界之力攻擊敵人。當目標是英雄時，忽略傷害分擔。第一場戰鬥開始時技能冷卻時間已滿。

S1.name: 伏擊
S1.description: 用染血的翅膀攻擊敵人，並將施法者的戰鬥準備度提高15%。在施法者回合使用時，有35%的機率發動力量作為額外效果。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 血之宴會
S2.description: 回合開始時，對攻擊力最高的敵人施加1回合詛咒。當施法者以外的後排隊友受到致命傷害時，消耗施法者30%的當前生命值，解除目標所有減益效果，然後給予1回合不死和吸血。

S3.name: 緋紅花園
S3.description: 解除敵人所有增益效果後，用血腥荊棘之地攻擊。此攻擊的效果命中增加50%，傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 魔法設計
S1.description: 用法杖攻擊，有50%的機率降低攻擊力2回合。

S2.name: 快速治療
S2.description: 恢復隊友的生命值並給予1回合護盾，然後減少技能冷卻時間1回合。恢復量和護盾強度隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 治癒禱告
S3.description: 解除所有隊友的減益效果後進行治療。治療量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 腳踝斬
S1.description: 用劍攻擊敵人，將施法者的戰鬥準備度提高20%。

S2.name: 劍風
S2.description: 用劍風攻擊所有敵人，有80%的機率使其2回合內無法獲得增益效果。當敵人數量為3個或更少時，敵人越少傷害越高。

S3.name: 閃電
S3.description: 反覆攻擊敵人，給予施法者2回合弱點共享。暴擊時有100%的機率降低防禦力2回合。

S1.name: 魔力釋放
S1.description: 用魔法書的力量攻擊，有35%的機率使其眩暈1回合。

S2.name: 英雄氣概
S2.description: 每當施法者以外的隊友受到攻擊時，戰鬥準備度增加12%。

S3.name: 魔力封印
S3.description: 用封印咒語對所有敵人造成巨大傷害，有170%的機率解除1個增益效果，然後有170%的機率增加技能冷卻時間1回合。

S1.name: X斬擊
S1.description: 用劍攻擊，傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 指揮打擊
S2.description: 反覆攻擊敵人後，觸發攻擊力最高的隊友進行協同攻擊。

S3.name: 淨化之焰
S3.description: 用劍暴風強力攻擊所有敵人，然後恢復施法者的生命值並增加所有隊友2回合的防禦力。恢復量和傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 寂靜射擊
S1.description: 安靜地射擊敵人，有75%的機率降低防禦力1回合。

S2.name: 機動支援
S2.description: 回合結束時，將施法者以外攻擊力最高的隊友的戰鬥準備度提高20%。

S3.name: 火力方塊
S3.description: 投擲火力方塊攻擊所有敵人，然後治療所有隊友並給予2回合攻擊力和速度提升。恢復量隨目標最大生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 冰劍風暴
S1.description: 用劍攻擊，有75%的機率嘲諷1回合。從對手處移除4個靈魂。施法者憤怒時忽略效果抵抗。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 戰鬥指揮
S2.description: 被攻擊後，當隊友有減益效果時，有100%的機率解除所有隊友的1個減益效果，並使施法者憤怒1回合。每回合只能發動1次。

S3.name: 閃光
S3.description: 用瞬間劍暴風攻擊所有敵人，有80%的機率使其眩暈1回合。施法者憤怒時忽略效果抵抗。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 睡眠咒語
S1.description: 用水能量攻擊敵人，有50%的機率使其睡眠1回合。

S2.name: 淨化
S2.description: 解除所有隊友的1個減益效果並治療有減益效果的隊友。恢復量隨隊友最大生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 真誠禱告
S3.description: 解除隊友的2個減益效果後恢復生命值並給予2回合免疫。恢復量隨隊友最大生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 神聖打擊
S1.description: 用法杖攻擊，有25%的機率使其眩暈1回合。

S2.name: 生命之源
S2.description: 用治癒力量恢復隊友的生命值。恢復量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 女神的指引
S3.description: 恢復所有隊友的生命值並給予2回合護盾和免疫。恢復量和護盾強度隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 幽靈之斧
S1.description: 用斧頭攻擊敵人並造成傷口，然後吸收部分傷害作為生命值。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。傷口嚴重程度隨傷害量按比例增加。每次使用此技能時降低目標最大生命值最多10%。

S2.name: 戰神之力
S2.description: 暴擊率增加30%。第一場戰鬥以50鬥志開始。施法者被攻擊時消耗10鬥志將施法者的戰鬥準備度提高15%並恢復施法者的生命值。恢復量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 救贖：靈魂交換
S3.description: 對敵人施加神聖審判。敵人被擊敗時以15%生命值復活一名隨機死亡的隊友並給予1次技能無效化。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。每當有人死亡時此技能的傷害量增加。效果最多疊加3次。

S1.name: 點燃
S1.description: 用火焰爆炸攻擊敵人，有50%的機率使其灼燒1回合。

S2.name: 催化劑
S2.description: 用催化爆炸攻擊所有敵人，解除2個增益效果並使其2回合無法被治療，然後增加所有隊友2回合的攻擊力。每造成1個無法被治療效果，施法者的戰鬥準備度增加30%。

S3.name: 火柱
S3.description: 用巨大火柱攻擊所有敵人，各有100%的機率造成2個2回合灼燒效果和100%的機率使其眩暈1回合。給予施法者2回合護盾。護盾強度隨施法者攻擊力按比例增加。

S1.name: 橫掃
S1.description: 用劍暴風快速攻擊兩名敵人，有50%的機率降低其戰鬥準備度15%。

S2.name: 黑暗契約
S2.description: 受到致命傷害時，生命值恢復至100%，施法者的戰鬥準備度增加100%，完全恢復施法者的專注度，並重置黑暗之刃的技能冷卻時間。

S3.name: 黑暗之刃
S3.description: 攻擊所有敵人，降低其2回合的命中率。專注度滿時全部消耗，增加傷害量。用此技能擊敗敵人時不會進入冷卻。

S1.name: 影之呼喚
S1.description: 用影子攻擊兩名敵人，有50%的機率降低1回合命中率。不在施法者回合時效果觸發機率增加20%。傷害量隨施法者防禦力按比例增加。

S2.name: 黑暗的引導
S2.description: 暴擊率增加30%。使用技能後專注度滿時消耗所有專注度發動暗影幻影。暗影幻影：攻擊所有敵人，解除2個增益效果並降低戰鬥準備度30%。傷害量隨施法者防禦力按比例增加。

S3.name: 幽影時刻
S3.description: 使用影之力量增加施法者的防禦力並採取2回合反擊姿態。給予施法者以外的所有隊友2回合隱身和護盾。護盾強度隨施法者防禦力按比例增加。

S1.name: 盾擊
S1.description: 用劍和盾攻擊敵人，各有75%的機率解除1個增益效果2次。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 護衛
S2.description: 戰鬥開始時和施法者回合結束時給予施法者1回合護衛。施法者以外的隊友受到單體攻擊後施法者的戰鬥準備度增加10%。

S3.name: 防禦姿態
S3.description: 攻擊敵人，有100%的機率使其眩暈1回合。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 榻榻米返
S1.description: 反覆攻擊敵人，各有70%的機率造成2個2回合出血效果。暴擊時施法者的技能冷卻時間減少1回合。

S2.name: 連三途渡
S2.description: 用精湛劍術攻擊敵人，各有80%的機率造成3個2回合出血效果。1個出血效果忽略效果抵抗。暴擊時獲得額外回合。

S3.name: 臥龍天生
S3.description: 發動致命一擊，回合結束時引爆敵人身上的所有出血效果。暴擊時所有隊友的戰鬥準備度增加25%。

S1.name: 沙風
S1.description: 用風魔法攻擊。施法者有減益效果時有75%的機率將施法者的1個減益效果轉移給敵人並造成2回合隨機減益效果。

S2.name: 颶風
S2.description: 釋放熱沙颶風攻擊所有敵人，各有75%的機率降低2回合命中率和攻擊力。

S3.name: 沙暴
S3.description: 用沙魔法攻擊所有敵人，解除所有增益效果並降低戰鬥準備度30%，然後使其2回合無法獲得增益效果。

S1.name: 毀滅之光
S1.description: 用光線攻擊所有敵人，有65%的機率解除1個增益效果。在施法者回合使用時有35%的機率發動侵襲作為額外攻擊。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。侵襲：攻擊所有敵人，降低1回合速度和命中率。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 壓制之枷
S2.description: 敵人獲得的靈魂數量減少100%。回合開始時有100%的機率給予施法者1回合隨機增益效果。

S3.name: 終末
S3.description: 用職責之力攻擊所有敵人，將戰鬥準備度降低10%到30%的隨機數值並嘲諷1回合。增加施法者2回合的防禦力。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 破風扇
S1.description: 用扇子攻擊敵人，造成與敵人最大生命值成比例的傷害。當施法者的累積專注度為5以上時，消耗所有專注度並發動烈風扇。

S2.name: 蝴蝶扇
S2.description: 揮舞扇子攻擊所有敵人。

S3.name: 烈風扇
S3.description: 製造強力陣風攻擊所有敵人，有100%的機率降低2回合防禦力。當烈風扇由破風扇觸發時傷害量增加。

S1.name: 讓開
S1.description: 斬擊敵人進行攻擊。當施法者有多層屏障時傷害量增加。

S2.name: 宇宙感知
S2.description: 第一場戰鬥開始時獲得50鬥志。敵人額外回合開始時解除施法者的所有減益效果並給予2回合多層屏障，然後增加40%戰鬥準備度。敵人額外回合後的效果每2回合只能觸發1次。攻擊後當鬥志滿時消耗所有鬥志發動地獄之焰。地獄之焰：用暗炎球攻擊所有敵人。穿透目標30%的防禦力，當施法者有多層屏障時額外穿透目標30%的防禦力。

S3.name: 毫不留情
S3.description: 斬擊敵人的靈魂進行攻擊，增加施法者以外戰鬥準備度最高的隊友15%的戰鬥準備度。當施法者有多層屏障時獲得的鬥志翻倍。

S1.name: 連續斬擊
S1.description: 用劍快速攻擊敵人，恢復與造成傷害成比例的生命值。增加施法者15%的戰鬥準備度，當敵人被擊敗時額外增加施法者35%的戰鬥準備度。

S2.name: 詛咒之劍
S2.description: 生命值越低，攻擊力、防禦力和速度越高。戰鬥開始時給予施法者1回合不死。

S3.name: 劍術：龍
S3.description: 犧牲施法者20%的當前生命值攻擊所有敵人並增加施法者2回合的攻擊力。敵人被擊敗時增加施法者50%的戰鬥準備度。此技能無法觸發反擊。

S1.name: 落花
S1.description: 向敵人投擲劍，有75%的機率降低1回合防禦力。攻擊成功時造成與施法者攻擊力成比例的額外傷害。

S2.name: 女巫的詛咒
S2.description: 命中率增加50%。隊友和敵人都無法復活。受到致命傷害時給予1回合不死。不死效果每5回合只能觸發1次。

S3.name: 詛咒荊棘
S3.description: 用詛咒荊棘叢攻擊所有敵人，解除所有增益效果，有100%的機率使其2回合無法獲得增益效果。攻擊成功時造成與施法者攻擊力成比例的額外傷害。

S1.name: 上勾拳
S1.description: 用劍鞘攻擊敵人，給予施法者1回合隱身。

S2.name: 直覺
S2.description: 第一場戰鬥開始時給予2回合隱身。敵人使用非攻擊技能後，解除施法者的所有減益效果並用閃現攻擊隨機敵人。每2回合只能觸發1次。閃現：眨眼間斬擊敵人並增加施法者30%的戰鬥準備度。不受屬性不利影響。

S3.name: 雷鳴
S3.description: 反覆攻擊敵人，給予施法者2回合閃避增加和護盾。當敵人不是精英或首領怪物時忽略傷害分擔效果。護盾強度隨施法者攻擊力按比例增加。

S1.name: 玩火
S1.description: 用燃燒的劍攻擊，有75%的機率使目標1回合無法被治療。

S2.name: 連勝！
S2.description: 發射火焰，給予施法者攻擊力增加（大），重置全押！的冷卻時間，並給予額外回合。

S3.name: 全押！
S3.description: 用熊熊地獄之火攻擊，穿透50%的防禦力。

S1.name: 神秘之箭
S1.description: 召喚神秘弓攻擊敵人，然後增加施法者15%的戰鬥準備度。當霜暴因冷卻而無法使用時發動隨機隊友的協同攻擊。

S2.name: 光輝爆發
S2.description: 引爆魔法球，使其眩暈1回合並2回合無法獲得增益效果。增加施法者50%的戰鬥準備度。

S3.name: 霜暴
S3.description: 用狂暴的霜暴攻擊所有敵人，減少增益效果持續時間1回合，然後各有100%的機率降低2回合速度並束縛。以有利屬性攻擊。

S1.name: 電擊
S1.description: 用電攻擊。暴擊時傷害量增加。

S2.name: 電力充能
S2.description: 當隊友造成暴擊時根據暴擊次數給予施法者可疊加的攻擊力增加。此效果在攻擊後解除。

S3.name: 超級充能
S3.description: 釋放強大電力，增加所有隊友3回合的暴擊率並增加20%戰鬥準備度。施法者也獲得額外回合。

S1.name: 斬擊
S1.description: 用巨劍攻擊，有60%的機率降低1回合攻擊力。使用此技能後有25%的機率發動重擊作為額外攻擊。當敵人有增益效果時發動重擊的機率翻倍。

S2.name: 重擊
S2.description: 用巨劍反覆攻擊敵人，有100%的機率解除所有增益效果。傷害量隨施法者被給予的增益效果數量按比例增加。

S3.name: 忠誠一擊
S3.description: 用劍暴風攻擊所有敵人，增加所有隊友2回合的攻擊力和防禦力。當敵人為3名以下時敵人越少傷害越高。

S1.name: 雙劍
S1.description: 用雙劍攻擊，有50%的機率降低1回合攻擊力。當施法者有增益效果時雙劍在施法者回合使用會變成攻擊所有敵人。使用此變化攻擊後增加施法者20%的戰鬥準備度，此變化攻擊成功時必定暴擊。此變化攻擊不會發動協同攻擊。

S2.name: 沼澤之志
S2.description: 被攻擊後施法者獲得20鬥志並被給予1回合攻擊力和防禦力增加。在施法者回合被攻擊時獲得的鬥志翻倍。攻擊力和防禦力增加每回合只能給予1次。

S3.name: 漩渦
S3.description: 旋轉斬擊所有敵人使其2回合無法被治療。使用此技能後獲得100鬥志。

S1.name: 劈砍
S1.description: 用槍攻擊敵人後增加施法者20%的戰鬥準備度。暴擊時獲得的專注度翻倍。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 呼呼呼！
S2.description: 狂野揮舞長槍攻擊敵人並吸收造成傷害的一部分作為生命值。穿透敵人70%的防禦力。當施法者累積專注度為5時消耗所有專注度增加傷害量並重置呼呼呼！的冷卻時間。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 救救我，奶油！
S3.description: 與奶油一起攻擊前凍結所有敵人。增加所有隊友2回合的暴擊抵抗。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。此技能因冷卻而無法使用時施法者以外的隊友被攻擊後有20%的機率反擊。

S1.name: 嚴酷教訓
S1.description: 用鐵球攻擊，有50%的機率降低2回合防禦力。

S2.name: 狂怒
S2.description: 當敵人被嚴酷教訓或歇斯底里擊敗時施法者狂怒3回合並發動呀哈哈哈。呀哈哈哈：揮舞鐵球攻擊所有敵人。

S3.name: 歇斯底里
S3.description: 旋轉攻擊所有敵人。當敵人被擊敗時重置技能冷卻時間。當施法者處於狂怒狀態時傷害量增加。

S1.name: 排除
S1.description: 銳利地斬擊敵人進行攻擊。在施法者回合使用且施法者有洞察時使用毀滅代替排除。毀滅：用劍攻擊敵人並吸收造成傷害的一部分作為生命值。傷害量隨目標損失的生命值按比例增加。當敵人被擊敗時降臨的冷卻時間減少1回合。此攻擊不會發動協同攻擊。

S2.name: 逼近者
S2.description: 第一場戰鬥開始時增加1回合閃避。施法者以外的隊友攻擊後當敵人生命值低於40%時增加施法者50%的戰鬥準備度並給予2回合洞察。每2回合只能觸發1次。

S3.name: 降臨
S3.description: 降臨後攻擊所有敵人並增加所有隊友2回合的攻擊力然後增加20%戰鬥準備度。此技能無法觸發反擊。

S1.name: 盾擊

S2.name: 粉碎

S3.name: 怒火降臨
S3.description: 釋放鬥志給予施法者3回合不屈和額外回合。第一場戰鬥以50鬥志開始。被攻擊時獲得10鬥志。

S1.name: 擊倒

S2.name: 再生

S1.name: 審判之光

S2.name: 女神的祝福

S3.name: 聖者的祈禱
S3.description: 女神的奇蹟顯現，增加所有隊友3回合的攻擊力，然後增加施法者50%的戰鬥準備度。

S1.name: 我用這個抓魚
S1.description: 用魔法力量攻擊所有敵人，各有25%的機率眩暈1回合。對有減益效果的敵人傷害量增加。

S2.name: 伽瑪射線

S3.name: 情緒化伽瑪射線
S3.description: 釋放巨大爆炸攻擊所有敵人。攻擊落空但無論如何都會施加2回合速度、攻擊力和命中率降低。

S1.name: 彈幕

S2.name: 守護者的權威

S3.name: 永恆閃耀的彗星

S3.name: 光之守護

S2.name: 憎恨之劍

S3.name: 王位繼承人
S3.description: 用劍攻擊敵人並採取反擊姿態，給予施法者2回合護盾。當敵人被擊敗時延長施法者的buff持續時間1回合並給予額外回合。當敵人最大生命值大於施法者時根據差異按比例增加傷害量最高70%。護盾強度隨施法者攻擊力按比例增加。

S3.name: 茶會

S1.name: 錯誤
S1.description: 用復仇之槍攻擊敵人，有100%的機率嘲諷1回合。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 強烈本能
S2.description: 減少隊友從英雄受到的額外傷害和固定傷害50%。當有多個傷害減免效果時只套用最強的效果。回合結束時給予生命值最低的隊友2回合護盾。護盾強度隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 怨恨之槍

S2.name: 士氣提升
S2.description: 提升所有隊友的士氣，給予2回合暴擊率增加。

S3.name: 致命彈

S1.name: 英雄一擊
S1.description: 用大劍擊倒敵人，有75%的機率嘲諷1回合。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 先鋒

S3.name: 衝鋒命令

S1.name: 低語精靈

S2.name: 精靈的守護

S1.name: 超音速踢擊

S2.name: 草原之鷹

S3.name: 君主的火焰一擊

S1.description: 用劍攻擊，有50%的機率降低1回合命中率並造成與施法者損失生命值成比例的傷害。使用此技能時若非由協同攻擊發動且施法者有增益效果則此技能變為攻擊所有敵人的攻擊。變更後的攻擊不會發動協同攻擊。

S2.name: 不滅意志
S2.description: 施法者受到致命傷害時給予1回合不死和2回合閃避率增加並重置末日技能冷卻時間。每6回合只能發動1次。

S3.name: 末日
S3.description: 爆發劍中蘊含的大魔王之力攻擊敵人後吸收造成傷害的一部分作為生命值。敵人被擊敗時延長施法者增益效果持續時間1回合。傷害量隨施法者損失生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 擊倒
S1.description: 用連擊攻擊，有50%的機率降低2回合防禦力。施法者有鬥志時燒傷敵人2回合。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 天昇腳
S2.description: 用連續踢擊攻擊敵人並降低2回合防禦力後給予施法者2回合速度增加。施法者有鬥志時無視效果抵抗。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 鳳凰亂舞
S3.description: 用連擊攻擊後施以強力一擊並眩暈1回合。給予施法者3回合鬥志。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。首次戰鬥開始時獲得40戰意。

S1.name: 劍風
S1.description: 用劍風攻擊敵人，有75%的機率嘲諷1回合。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 衝鋒
S2.description: 用盾牌推擠敵人並降低50%戰鬥準備度後給予所有隊友2回合防禦力增加。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 召喚齊格菲
S3.description: 召喚守護者齊格菲攻擊，造成與施法者損失生命值成比例的傷害並穿透防禦力。此攻擊無法觸發暴擊。

S1.name: 射擊
S1.description: 用槍火攻擊敵人並增加施法者15%的戰鬥準備度。當目標有增益效果時戰鬥準備度增加和戰意獲得效果加倍。

S2.name: 隊長登場
S2.description: 首次戰鬥開始時獲得50戰意並給予1回合隱匿。回合開始時每個敵人的增益效果獲得10戰意，戰意滿時重置技能冷卻時間。攻擊後增加施法者25%攻擊力。此效果最多可疊加3次。

S3.name: 全力爆發
S3.description: 對所有敵人射擊並給予所有隊友2回合速度增加後增加15%戰鬥準備度。戰意滿時消耗所有戰意穿透目標50%防禦力。此攻擊不會觸發反擊。

S1.name: 懲罰
S1.description: 用劍風攻擊敵人後增加施法者1回合速度。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 代號00
S2.description: 被攻擊後減少1回合技能冷卻時間。受到攻擊所有隊友的攻擊後額外減少1回合技能冷卻時間並給予所有隊友2回合護盾。護盾強度隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。護盾效果每回合只能發動1次。

S3.name: 機動兵器齊格菲
S3.description: 召喚齊格菲攻擊所有敵人並減少所有隊友1回合技能冷卻時間。穿透防禦力且無法觸發暴擊。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值和速度按比例增加。每次使用此技能時傷害量增加最多可疊加3次。

S1.name: 野玫瑰
S1.description: 用劍攻擊敵人，各有80%的機率施加2個1回合流血效果。回合結束時引爆施加在目標身上的流血效果。

S2.name: 荊棘叢
S2.description: 攻擊前對所有敵人施加60%資源減少並減少1回合增益效果持續時間和施加2回合束縛。每個目標增加施法者25%戰鬥準備度。

S3.name: 公開處刑
S3.description: 用鞭劍攻擊敵人並施加2回合防禦力降低後降低100%戰鬥準備度。給予所有隊友1次技能無效化。目標有束縛時無視效果抵抗。

S1.name: 跟我來！衝鋒！
S1.description: 帶頭攻擊敵人並發動隨機隊友的協同攻擊。攻擊時暴擊率增加50%並且傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 到此為止！
S2.description: 敵人使用非攻擊技能後解除施法者1個減益效果並對敵方施法者發動壓制。壓制每2回合只能發動1次。壓制：嘲諷目標1回合並給予施法者2回合護盾。護盾強度隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 準備、裝填、射擊！
S3.description: 命令珀蘭德軍隊對所有敵人射擊並降低25%戰鬥準備度。攻擊時暴擊率增加50%並根據攻擊力最高的英雄的攻擊力造成傷害。

S1.name: 咔嚓咔嚓
S1.description: 刺擊並斬擊敵人，有50%的機率使其2回合無法獲得增益效果。

S2.name: 剪剪剪
S2.description: 殘忍地斬擊敵人，各有55%的機率施加3個2回合流血效果後增加施法者50%戰鬥準備度。

S3.name: 靈魂切割者
S3.description: 用喬和瑪斬擊敵人並給予施法者1次技能無效化。敵人被擊敗時施加消滅並減少施法者1回合技能冷卻時間。使用此技能時命中率增加20%。

S1.name: 審判
S1.description: 用巨劍攻擊後給予施法者1回合免疫。

S2.name: 女王的威嚴
S2.description: 暴擊受到的傷害減少30%。施法者以外的所有隊友暴擊受到的傷害減少15%。當有多個傷害減免效果時只套用最強的效果。施法者受到暴擊的瞬間增加施法者15%戰鬥準備度。

S3.name: 拉瑪雷的意志
S3.description: 用劍砸擊敵人並攻擊。敵人被擊敗時施加消滅。穿透目標50%防禦力。目標為暗屬性英雄時傷害量增加並對目標以外的所有敵人造成與施法者攻擊力成比例的額外傷害。

S1.name: 狂野波濤
S1.description: 用強烈的元素力量攻擊，有50%的機率降低2回合防禦力。傷害量隨敵人損失生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 雷科斯的祝福
S2.description: 用星辰的祝福給予所有隊友2回合防禦力增加和護盾。護盾強度隨施法者攻擊力按比例增加。

S3.name: 復仇之波
S3.description: 用毀滅之力攻擊所有敵人，有100%的機率降低2回合防禦力。

S1.name: 無限斬
S1.description: 隨機次數刺擊目標。技能冷卻時間減少1-3回合並根據攻擊次數傷害量增加。

S2.name: 龍騎士的意志
S2.description: 暴擊率和暴擊抵抗增加90%。施法者生命值50%以上時攻擊力增加90%，施法者生命值低於50%時防禦力增加90%。

S3.name: 拉格納槍
S3.description: 騰空而起用槍擊落敵人，有100%的機率降低2回合防禦力。穿透目標50%防禦力。敵人被擊敗時額外獲得5個靈魂。

S1.name: 擊倒
S1.description: 用連擊攻擊敵人，有100%的機率嘲諷1回合。攻擊成功時必定觸發暴擊。

S2.name: 龍炎
S2.description: 戰鬥開始時給予3回合鬥志。施法者以外的隊友受到暴擊時反擊，施法者受到暴擊時用龍炎反擊。龍炎(獲得1個靈魂)：用踢擊攻擊敵人並穿透目標50%防禦力。攻擊成功時必定觸發暴擊並造成與施法者損失生命值成比例的傷害。

S3.name: 阿修羅降臨
S3.description: 用強力的地面衝擊攻擊所有敵人，有80%的機率降低2回合防禦力。攻擊成功時必定觸發暴擊。

S1.name: 威力
S1.description: 壓制敵人，有75%的機率使其1回合無法恢復。傷害量隨施法者損失生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 顯現
S2.description: 釋放內心的憤怒攻擊後給予施法者1回合不死和免疫。敵人被擊敗時此技能冷卻時間重置。傷害量隨施法者損失生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 鮮血綻放
S3.description: 攻擊前解除敵人所有增益效果並釋放壓抑的攻擊性攻擊，無論是否命中都會施加2回合詛咒。此技能不受屬性劣勢影響。精英或首領怪物無法被詛咒。

S1.name: 龍潛
S1.description: 攻擊敵人並根據造成的傷害恢復生命值後增加施法者1回合攻擊力。

S2.name: 龍眼 (米莉姆之眼)
S2.description: 戰鬥開始時和回合結束時有100%的機率給予施法者1回合龍眼(米莉姆之眼)。回合開始時被授予龍眼(米莉姆之眼)時解除所有敵人的隱匿。無視效果抵抗。攻擊後專注力滿時消耗所有專注力發動龍破。龍破：用壓倒性的魔力攻擊所有敵人並移除10個靈魂。

S3.name: 龍懼
S3.description: 釋放魔力攻擊敵人，敵人被擊敗時施加消滅。增加施法者3回合迴避率。

S1.name: 重擊
S1.description: 用錘子攻擊，有40%的機率眩暈1回合。攻擊後目標被眩暈時增加施法者以外所有隊友15%戰鬥準備度。

S2.name: 女僕的加油
S2.description: 增加所有隊友20%效果抵抗。回合開始時恢復生命值最低的兩名隊友的生命值。恢復量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: VIP待遇
S3.description: 用VIP待遇招待所有隊友，將所有死亡隊友復活至20%生命值。解除所有存活隊友2個減益效果並給予3回合復活。

S1.name: 殲滅
S1.description: 貫穿敵人攻擊，有50%的機率降低2回合防禦力。無視最大生命值低於施法者最大生命值的目標的效果抵抗。

S2.name: 絕對威嚴
S2.description: 免疫阻礙移動的減益效果。施法者以外的所有英雄無法反擊。隊友被攻擊時有20%的機率反擊，反擊時發動神聖祝福。神聖祝福每3回合只能發動1次。神聖祝福：給予所有隊友2回合護盾並增加施法者2回合速度。護盾強度隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 降臨：摩特利克斯
S3.description: 降臨攻擊所有敵人並施加2回合恐懼後恢復施法者生命值。穿透最大生命值最高敵人70%防禦力並無視最大生命值低於施法者最大生命值的目標的效果抵抗。傷害量和恢復量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 颶風劍
S1.description: 用槍攻擊敵人，有75%的機率降低1回合命中率。傷害量隨施法者速度按比例增加。

S2.name: 風暴子彈
S2.description: 對所有敵人發射強風。傷害量隨施法者速度按比例增加。此技能不會觸發反擊。

S3.name: 毀滅追擊
S3.description: 迅速斬擊並射擊敵人。敵人非精英或首領怪物時無視傷害分擔效果。傷害量隨施法者速度按比例增加。

S1.name: 狼爪
S1.description: 用銳利的爪子斬擊敵人，有40%的機率眩暈1回合。施法者有護盾時效果機率增加25%。

S2.name: 懲罰之刃
S2.description: 用守護靈攻擊所有敵人並減少1回合增益效果持續時間後施加2回合束縛並使其無法獲得增益效果。

S3.name: 群獵
S3.description: 使用誓約聖杯之力增加施法者以外所有隊友2回合攻擊力後給予施法者3回合隱匿、護衛和護盾。護盾強度隨施法者等級按比例增加。

S1.name: 星辰召喚
S1.description: 召喚人偶攻擊敵人，有40%的機率眩暈1回合。

S2.name: 星界嚮導
S2.description: 敵人非精英或首領怪物時將敵人獲得的戰鬥準備度增加效果減少50%。此效果不與同名其他被動效果疊加。敵人使用非攻擊技能時發動靜謐。靜謐每2回合只能發動1次。靜謐：攻擊所有敵人並減少1回合增益效果持續時間後增加施法者30%戰鬥準備度。

S3.name: 星落
S3.description: 用外星科技攻擊所有敵人，有100%的機率使其2回合無法獲得增益效果。

S1.name: 暴風
S1.description: 用劍風攻擊敵人。穿透目標20%防禦力。傷害量隨施法者速度按比例增加。

S2.name: 精神集中
S2.description: 給予所有隊友2回合免疫後增加施法者2回合攻擊力。給予施法者額外回合。

S3.name: 瞬刃
S3.description: 用劍攻擊所有敵人並解除2個增益效果後有85%的機率施加2回合烙印和85%的機率降低2回合防禦力。傷害量隨施法者和目標速度按比例增加。

S1.name: 交給我吧。
S1.description: 用晨星攻擊敵人，有50%的機率降低2回合防禦力。施法者處於惡魔模式時用相同技能追加攻擊。

S2.name: 女僕的驕傲
S2.description: 有人死亡時解除施法者所有減益效果並給予2回合惡魔模式。每5回合只能發動1次。施法者以外的隊友被攻擊時有20%的機率用鐵擊反擊。鐵擊優先於基本技能反擊。鐵擊：攻擊所有敵人並減少1回合增益效果持續時間和使其1回合無法恢復。

S3.name: 我要懲罰你！
S3.description: 增加施法者3回合攻擊力後跳起攻擊所有敵人並降低2回合命中率。

S1.name: 那麼，開始吧？
S1.description: 斬擊敵人攻擊並給予施法者1回合隨機增益效果。

S2.name: 分析與評估
S2.description: 用非基本技能攻擊後若目標有增益效果無論是否命中都複製2個增益效果並給予所有隊友。此效果不適用於無法解除的增益效果。有增益效果的敵人攻擊隊友時對攻擊者發動準備好！準備好！每3回合只能發動1次。準備好！：快速接近敵人攻擊並增加施法者30%戰鬥準備度。

S3.name: 吞噬吧，黑炎！
S3.description: 用黑炎攻擊敵人，攻擊成功時對目標造成5,000額外固定傷害。固定傷害隨所有隊友獲得的增益效果數量按比例增加最高10,000固定傷害。不受屬性劣勢影響。

S1.name: 靈魂淨化
S1.description: 用高貴之力攻擊敵人並給予生命值最低的隊友2回合護盾。護盾強度隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。攻擊後給予所有隊友2回合護盾。

S2.name: 警戒之眼
S2.description: 隊友被追加攻擊、反擊或協同攻擊時恢復所有隊友生命值並每名被攻擊隊友增加所有隊友5%戰鬥準備度。恢復量與施法者最大生命值和被攻擊隊友數量成比例。

S3.name: 高貴的雷科斯
S3.description: 用雷科斯的恩典給予所有隊友2回合護盾和復活。護盾強度隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 劍閃
S1.description: 斬擊敵人，有75%的機率降低1回合命中率。給予額外回合。

S2.name: 集中
S2.description: 迴避率增加50%，成功迴避後獲得1點專注力。攻擊後或被攻擊後專注力為5時消耗所有專注力對隨機敵人使用屠殺。

S3.name: 屠殺
S3.description: 用劍攻擊敵人。穿透目標50%防禦力。

S1.name: 復仇之槍
S1.description: 用槍攻擊敵人，有75%的機率嘲諷1回合。非施法者回合時效果機率增加25%。

S2.name: 不屈之魂
S2.description: 攻擊力增加30%，暴擊抵抗增加50%。攻擊時無法觸發暴擊。被攻擊時若受到非暴擊傷害則在發動戰場恩典前對攻擊者造成與施法者攻擊力成比例的傷害。戰場恩典每2回合只能發動1次。戰場恩典：給予所有隊友2回合護盾並增加施法者2回合速度。護盾強度隨施法者攻擊力按比例增加。

S3.name: 屠龍者之擊
S3.description: 用槍向下攻擊所有敵人，有100%的機率降低2回合命中率和100%的機率嘲諷1回合。技能冷卻時間減少2回合。

S1.name: 小心
S1.description: 用扇子攻擊敵人，有75%的機率標記1回合。

S2.name: 和朋友們一起
S2.description: 每名存活隊友減少10%受到的傷害。當有多個同類傷害減免效果時只套用最強的效果。隊友被攻擊時獲得1點專注力，施法者專注力為5時消耗所有專注力發動你不可愛。你不可愛：用扇子攻擊所有敵人，有75%的機率降低2回合防禦力。

S3.name: 我不是警告過你嗎？
S3.description: 用水花攻擊所有敵人並解除所有增益效果後各有100%的機率施加2回合無法獲得增益效果和無法恢復。無視效果抵抗。

S1.name: 斬
S1.description: 用鐮刀攻擊，各有50%的機率施加2個2回合流血效果。

S2.name: 強擊
S2.description: 用鐮刀猛擊敵人，各有100%的機率施加2回合無法恢復和流血。攻擊後敵人生命值50%以下時以100%的機率施加流血的追加攻擊發動斬。給予額外回合。

S3.name: 斷頭台
S3.description: 穿刺敵人弱點造成致命傷害。穿透30%防禦力並每個敵人身上的減益效果追加穿透5%。敵人被擊敗時施加消滅。

S1.name: 強力一擊
S1.description: 揮劍攻擊敵人並增加施法者20%戰鬥準備度。

S2.name: 毀滅之眼
S2.description: 用力量波攻擊所有敵人並解除2個增益效果。無視攻擊力低於施法者目標的效果抵抗。敵人3名以下時敵人越少傷害越高。

S3.name: 星辰消滅
S3.description: 用劍攻擊所有敵人。穿透最大生命值最高目標30%防禦力。施法者攻擊力高於穿透目標攻擊力時穿透率按差值比例增加最高100%。此技能無法誘發反擊。

S1.name: 寧靜旋律
S1.description: (塔瑪琳娜) 用寧靜旋律攻擊敵人並治療生命值最低的隊友。恢復量隨隊友最大生命值按比例增加。減少閃耀之星☆1回合冷卻時間。(偶像) 用美麗歌聲攻擊所有敵人並解除所有增益效果。觸發攻擊力最高隊友的協同攻擊。

S2.name: 森林之歌
S2.description: (塔瑪琳娜) 用平和旋律治療所有隊友。恢復量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。減少閃耀之星☆1回合冷卻時間。(偶像) 用強力表演增加所有隊友2回合攻擊力並增加50%戰鬥準備度恢復生命值。恢復量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 閃耀之星☆
S3.description: 表演前解除所有隊友身上的所有減益效果並將施法者生命值恢復至最大。施法者成為偶像3回合進行演唱會。首次戰鬥開始時冷卻時間為最大。

S1.name: 黑暗爆發
S1.description: 用黑暗能量爆發攻擊敵人，有70%的機率使其睡眠1回合。此技能不會觸發協同攻擊。

S2.name: 不祥之雷
S2.description: 召喚不祥之雷攻擊所有敵人降低30%戰鬥準備度並施加2回合速度降低和束縛。

S3.name: 噩夢
S3.description: 對所有敵人落下噩夢之月，各有85%的機率降低2回合防禦力並使其睡眠1回合後增加施法者2回合攻擊力。

S1.name: 能量爆發
S1.description: 使用戰衣能量攻擊敵人。在施法者回合使用時有40%的機率用相同技能追加攻擊。敵人非精英或首領怪物時無視傷害分擔效果。

S2.name: 勝利姿態
S2.description: 發動戰衣能量給予施法者3回合護盾。給予施法者額外回合。護盾強度隨施法者等級按比例增加。

S3.name: 毀滅
S3.description: 增加施法者3回合攻擊力後用次元能量攻擊敵人，敵人被擊敗時施加消滅。增加所有隊友20%戰鬥準備度並給予施法者2回合隱匿。傷害量隨施法者速度按比例增加。

S1.name: 橫掃
S1.description: 用劍風快速攻擊兩名敵人。傷害量隨施法者速度按比例增加。

S2.name: 舞劍
S2.description: 增加施法者2回合攻擊力，橫掃或劍之飛翔擊敗敵人時發動舞劍。舞劍（獲得1靈魂）：用劍風攻擊所有敵人。

S3.name: 劍之飛翔
S3.description: 用劍風攻擊所有敵人，造成與施法者速度成比例的傷害。

S1.name: 優雅斬擊
S1.description: 用劍攻擊，有75%的機率降低1回合攻擊力。非施法者回合時戰鬥準備度增加15%並獲得雙倍專注力。

S2.name: 接受決鬥
S2.description: 解除施法者2個減益效果並給予3回合洞察後恢復15%生命值準備決鬥。給予施法者額外回合。

S3.name: 蝶斬
S3.description: 用劍穿刺敵人並消耗所有專注力。傷害量隨消耗的專注力按比例增加。蝶斬根據冷卻時間可用時迴避率增加35%，成功迴避後用優雅斬擊反擊。

S1.name: 生命汲取
S1.description: 用岩石砸擊敵人並增加施法者15%戰鬥準備度。

S2.name: 雷神之吼
S2.description: 用雷暴攻擊所有敵人。敵人被擊敗時再次發動雷神之吼。這樣發動的每個後續雷神之吼傷害減少，最多可發動3次。

S3.name: 魔力增幅
S3.description: 完全增幅魔力給予所有隊友3回合免疫後給予施法者3回合攻擊力增加（大）同時增加施法者以外所有隊友3回合攻擊力。

S1.name: 狙擊手
S1.description: 用步槍射擊敵人，有50%的機率標記2回合。

S2.name: 速射
S2.description: 用步槍射擊所有敵人，有100%的機率解除1個增益效果並增加施法者2回合速度。

S3.name: 終結射擊
S3.description: 用魔力子彈攻擊敵人。穿透目標的防禦力。

S1.name: 雙重斬擊
S1.description: 揮動武器攻擊，有50%的機率降低2回合防禦力。

S2.name: 龍嘯
S2.description: 用龍吼攻擊所有敵人並解除1個增益效果後有155%的機率降低2回合防禦力和155%的機率施加1回合沉默。無視效果抵抗。

S3.name: 飛龍衝鋒
S3.description: 給予施法者2回合攻擊力增加後用巨劍攻擊敵人。敵人被擊敗時給予額外回合。根據冷卻時間此技能可用時施法者以外的隊友使用技能後若敵人有減益效果則增加施法者20%戰鬥準備度。

S1.name: 暴露弱點
S1.description: 用長劍攻擊敵人。攻擊時暴擊率增加50%。目標有增益效果時傷害量增加。

S2.name: 精密計劃
S2.description: 解除隊友和施法者2個減益效果後增加隊友15%戰鬥準備度。給予施法者額外回合。

S3.name: 處刑
S3.description: 攻擊敵人造成傷痕後給予施法者1回合無敵。攻擊時暴擊率增加50%。傷痕嚴重程度隨傷害量按比例增加。每次使用此技能傷痕最多降低目標35%最大生命值。

S1.name: 劍風暴
S1.description: 用劍風攻擊，有75%的機率解除1個增益效果。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 戰術指揮
S2.description: 免疫阻礙移動的減益效果。後排隊友被攻擊後有阻礙移動的減益效果時對目標發動指揮吶喊。每2回合可發動1次。指揮吶喊：解除隊友所有減益效果並給予2回合免疫。

S3.name: 全面進攻
S3.description: 劍風後再次攻擊所有敵人，有100%的機率降低2回合防禦力並增加所有隊友2回合防禦力。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 追蹤雷射
S1.description: 用無人機攻擊所有敵人後增加施法者15%戰鬥準備度並增加施法者以外所有隊友5%戰鬥準備度。

S2.name: 升級
S2.description: 用無人機強化所有隊友並增加3回合攻擊力。給予施法者額外回合。

S3.name: 流星砲
S3.description: 用砲攻擊所有敵人。敵人3人以下時敵人越少傷害量越高。

S1.name: 黑棘
S1.description: 用棘刺攻擊，有35%的機率造成1回合暈眩。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 星之鎧
S2.description: 敵人使用非攻擊技能時增加施法者防禦力和古代野獸傷害量10%並增加效果命中5%。最多疊加8次。

S3.name: 古代野獸
S3.description: 召喚古代野獸攻擊所有敵人，有80%的機率造成1回合沉默。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 槍炎
S1.description: 用火焰柱攻擊敵人。敵人沒有增益效果時傷害量增加。攻擊後鬥志為100時發動羅馬取消。無法由反擊觸發。羅馬取消：消耗所有鬥志延長施法者增益效果持續時間1回合後給予額外回合。

S2.name: 火山毒蛇
S2.description: 敵人使用非攻擊技能時增加施法者20%戰鬥準備度並獲得20鬥志。受到攻擊所有隊友的攻擊時對攻擊者發動火山毒蛇。每個效果每2回合只能發動1次。火山毒蛇：將敵人打向空中連續攻擊並施加2回合沉默。傷害量隨敵人最大生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 暴君狂怒 ver.Beta
S3.description: 用強力拳頭攻擊並解除所有增益效果。傷害量隨敵人最大生命值按比例增加。攻擊後無論是否命中都會造成額外傷害。

S1.name: 暗影
S1.description: 用黑暗能量攻擊敵人，有50%的機率施加1回合無法治癒。傷害量隨敵人損失的生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 頑強
S2.description: 被攻擊時單次攻擊受到的傷害不超過最大生命值的51%。施法者以外的隊友攻擊後目標生命值在30%以下時發動侵蝕。侵蝕每3回合只能發動1次。侵蝕：釋放黑暗能量攻擊所有敵人並增加施法者30%戰鬥準備度。傷害量隨目標損失的生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 信念
S3.description: 對敵人造成致命傷害。敵人被擊敗時施加滅絕並對目標以外的所有敵人造成與施法者攻擊力成比例的額外傷害。傷害量隨目標損失的生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 滿月鐮刀
S1.description: 用鐮刀攻擊。目標有增益效果時傷害量增加70%。

S2.name: 暗之傷痕
S2.description: 用鐮刀攻擊所有敵人。穿透敵人30%防禦力，施法者處於隱身狀態時額外穿透30%。

S3.name: 夜曲
S3.description: 跳向敵人攻擊。給予施法者2回合隱身和護盾後增加50%戰鬥準備度。護盾強度隨施法者攻擊力按比例增加。傷害量隨施法者當前生命值比例按比例增加。

S1.name: 強擊
S1.description: 用劍鞘攻擊敵人。非由雙重攻擊觸發且施法者有增益效果時改用敏捷之劍。敏捷之劍：給予施法者1回合攻擊力增加後快速攻擊並將部分傷害吸收為生命值。穿透50%防禦力。

S2.name: 第六感
S2.description: 單次攻擊受到的傷害不超過最大生命值的51%。有人死亡時技能冷卻時間減少1回合並獲得5個魂。此效果每回合只能發動1次。

S3.name: 靈門：燃燒附身
S3.description: 打開靈門復活所有死亡的隊友。給予所有隊友1回合不死並給予施法者3回合附身。

S1.name: 毒爆
S1.description: 用毒氣爆炸攻擊，有70%的機率施加2回合毒。無法觸發反擊。無盡噩夢冷卻中時攻擊2名敵人。

S2.name: 噩夢幻影
S2.description: 幻影在整場戰鬥中持續存在。每次有人死亡時施法者攻擊力和防禦力增加10%（最多5層）。

S3.name: 無盡噩夢
S3.description: 用噩夢水晶攻擊並造成1回合暈眩。敵人死亡時降低所有剩餘敵人50%戰鬥準備度。

S1.name: 誓約之鑰
S1.description: 用法杖攻擊敵人並恢復所有隊友生命值。傷害量和恢復量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 光之柱
S2.description: 召喚光之柱解除隊友所有減益效果並恢復生命值，同時給予2回合護盾和傷害限制。

S3.name: 升騰之光
S3.description: 用治癒魔法解除隊友所有減益效果後恢復50%生命值並給予1回合無敵。目標已死亡時以100%生命值復活再套用效果。

S1.name: 黑魔法
S1.description: 用魔法球攻擊並增加施法者15%戰鬥準備度。

S2.name: 魔力注入
S2.description: 對施法者以外的隊友注入魔力增加2回合攻擊力後增加100%戰鬥準備度。

S3.name: 荒蕪
S3.description: 釋放強力魔力攻擊所有敵人有155%的機率施加2回合沉默和防禦力降低。給予額外回合。

S1.name: 棘刺
S1.description: 用劍攻擊有75%的機率降低1回合命中率。

S2.name: 飛燕草
S2.description: 用劍束縛所有敵人有100%的機率解除1個增益效果後每個目標增加施法者25%戰鬥準備度。此技能不會觸發反擊。

S3.name: 歇斯底里
S3.description: 無差別攻擊敵人將技能冷卻時間增加到最大並增加所有隊友25%戰鬥準備度。暴擊時給予所有隊友1次技能無效。

S1.name: 混沌之觸
S1.description: 有100%的機率封印敵人2回合後用閃電攻擊。

S2.name: 扭曲之力
S2.description: 受到暴擊傷害降低30%。使用基本技能後目標被封印時增加施法者1回合攻擊力後發動爆發。爆發：攻擊所有敵人並增加施法者25%戰鬥準備度後獲得1集中。

S3.name: 溶解
S3.description: 用伊利歐斯之力攻擊所有敵人有180%的機率施加2回合防禦力降低和2個燒傷。給予施法者額外回合。

S1.name: 殘忍之觸
S1.description: 攻擊敵人有200%的機率施加1回合轉嫁挑釁。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 惡意微笑
S2.description: 被攻擊時反射受到傷害的40%給攻擊者。被攻擊後生命值在30%以下時解除施法者所有減益效果並發動殺意。殺意：給予施法者3回合護盾並增加25%戰鬥準備度。

S3.name: 苦痛交響曲
S3.description: 釋放虐待狂之球攻擊敵人。忽略傷害分擔效果。穿透目標防禦力但無法觸發暴擊。傷害量隨施法者損失的生命值按比例增加。

S1.name: 神聖閃電
S1.description: 用衝擊魔法攻擊2名敵人後增加施法者15%戰鬥準備度。

S2.name: 次元裂縫
S2.description: 用光球攻擊所有敵人有70%的機率解除1個增益效果。施法者有攻擊力增加時用相同技能追加攻擊。

S3.name: 卡爾的燃燒之眼
S3.description: 釋放古書之力攻擊所有敵人後增加施法者2回合攻擊力。完成第3章後揮發性變為巨大力量給予隊友被攻擊時反擊機率並增加次元裂縫傷害量。

S1.name: 走開喵！
S1.description: 用晨星攻擊。傷害量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。施法者有可愛時觸發攻擊力最高的隊友的雙重攻擊。

S2.name: 生氣喵！
S2.description: 憤怒地用晨星攻擊所有敵人有80%的機率施加2回合無法治癒。施法者有可愛時效果機率增加20%。忽略效果抵抗。

S3.name: 超級可愛喵♥
S3.description: 可愛地搖尾巴減少所有隊友減益效果持續時間2回合並給予施法者3回合免疫和可愛。給予施法者額外回合。

S1.name: 血鐮
S1.description: 揮動鐮刀攻擊並解除1個增益效果。解除目標增益效果時發動血之報復作為追加攻擊。血之報復：用鐮刀攻擊敵人並恢復所有隊友生命值。傷害量和恢復量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S2.name: 怨恨
S2.description: 攻擊時穿透目標防禦力且無法觸發暴擊。隊友死亡時給予所有隊友2回合護盾和免疫並給予施法者2回合血之氣息。護盾強度隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。每4回合只能發動1次。

S3.name: 月之斬

S3.description: 利用強化方塊的力量給予所有隊友2回合速度增加。

S1.name: 膝擊
S1.description: 用膝蓋擊打敵人有80%的機率降低1回合命中率。傷害量隨施法者速度按比例增加。

S2.name: 風壓
S2.description: 用風壓攻擊敵人。敵人被擊敗時再次發動風壓。傷害量隨施法者速度按比例增加。

S3.name: 不屈意志
S3.description: 向所有隊友釋放能量增加2回合攻擊力。

S1.name: 強化射擊
S1.description: 發射強化手槍有75%的機率解除敵人1個增益效果。

S2.name: 戰鬥支援
S2.description: 使用強化方塊支援所有隊友給予2回合攻擊力增加。給予施法者額外回合。

S3.name: 高密度爆炸方塊
S3.description: 用強力爆炸物攻擊所有敵人有100%的機率解除1個增益效果再有75%的機率降低2回合命中率。

S1.name: 自動射擊
S1.description: 用加特林機槍攻擊有90%的機率解除1個增益效果。傷害量隨施法者防禦力按比例增加。

S2.name: 防禦模式
S2.description: 攻擊後施法者防禦力增加10%。效果最多疊加5次。

S3.name: 清掃模式
S3.description: 對所有敵人進行無差別射擊有75%的機率降低1回合命中率再給予施法者2回合反擊。

S1.name: 雙劍
S1.description: 用雙劍攻擊有50%的機率降低2回合速度。傷害量隨施法者速度按比例增加。

S2.name: 閃避
S2.description: 閃避率增加50%。被攻擊時如果成功閃避則冷卻時間減少1回合並增加2回合速度。

S3.name: 突襲
S3.description: 埋伏攻擊目標使其沉默1回合。傷害量隨施法者速度按比例增加。

S1.name: 無情之劍
S1.description: 攻擊敵人後施法者攻擊力增加15%。擊敗敵人時施法者戰鬥準備度增加75%。

S2.name: 事前計畫
S2.description: 降低所有隊友減益效果持續時間1回合後給予施法者3回合護盾。給予施法者額外回合。

S3.name: 繳械
S3.description: 對目標施加100%資源減少後攻擊有100%的機率降低2回合攻擊力並造成1回合暈眩。

S1.name: 壓制射擊
S1.description: 用火力掩護攻擊敵人後給予施法者以外生命值最低的隊友2回合護盾。

S2.name: 恢復
S2.description: 使用恢復方塊回復目標的生命值。回復量隨施法者最大生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 方塊光環
S3.description: 使用恢復方塊給予所有隊友2回合免疫後回復生命值。

S1.name: 低語精靈
S1.description: 用精靈之力攻擊敵人有50%的機率降低2回合速度。

S2.name: 守護
S2.description: 用水之能量回復隊友的生命值並解除2個減益效果。回復量隨目標最大生命值按比例增加。

S3.name: 精靈的呼喚
S3.description: 用精靈之力回復所有隊友的生命值並給予2回合護盾。

S1.name: 投擲圓環
S1.description: 向敵人投擲圓環有75%的機率解除一個增益效果並增加施法者15%戰鬥準備度。

S2.name: 炫目之舞
S2.description: 以舞蹈迷惑敵人有75%的機率降低2回合防禦力後有50%的機率使用投擲圓環。

S3.name: 表演時間
S3.description: 以優雅舞蹈治療所有隊友並給予3回合隨機增益效果。

S1.name: 鎖鏈匕首
S1.description: 用鎖鏈斧攻擊。敵人處於流血狀態時造成2回合兩個流血效果。

S2.name: 銳利一擊
S2.description: 用鎖鏈斧強擊敵人造成2回合兩個流血效果並降低1回合攻擊力。

S3.name: 爆裂
S3.description: 觸發當前施加在敵人身上的所有流血效果。傷害量與流血效果數量成比例。

S1.name: 極端療法
S1.description: 投擲藥瓶攻擊，解除一位隊友的一個減益。

S2.name: 重生之光
S2.description: 照亮所有隊友，賦予2回合護盾。

S3.name: 激勵
S3.description: 解除所有隊友的所有減益來激勵團隊，並賦予2回合免疫。

S1.name: 擊倒
S1.description: 用盾牌攻擊敵人，35%機率賦予1回合暈眩。

S2.name: 保護
S2.description: 被攻擊時有15%機率反擊。當隊友受到單體攻擊時，減少受到的傷害。

S3.name: 盾牆
S3.description: 使用光之盾解除所有隊友的一個減益，並賦予2回合護盾。

S1.name: 屠殺
S1.description: 用雙刃斧攻擊敵人，吸收部分傷害作為生命值。

S2.name: 魔血
S2.description: 以60鬥志開始第一場戰鬥，根據施術者的最大生命值比例增加攻擊力。

S3.name: 惡魔疾馳
S3.description: 殘忍地攻擊所有敵人並造成負傷，75%機率賦予1回合暈眩。

S1.name: 使者之鐮
S1.description: 用巨大的鐮刀攻擊敵人，50%機率降低2回合防禦力。

S2.name: 血之裂傷
S2.description: 用鐮刀攻擊敵人並恢復所有友軍的生命值。

S3.name: 吸血印記
S3.description: 用使者之鐮攻擊所有敵人，解除2個增益效果後，85%機率賦予2回合2個流血效果。

S1.name: 星光
S1.description: 用魔法攻擊，75%機率偷取1個增益效果。

S2.name: 月光一擊
S2.description: 用光攻擊敵人，減少增益效果持續時間1回合後，100%機率賦予1回合暈眩。

S3.name: 滿月的呼喚
S3.description: 用夜曲魔法攻擊所有敵人。穿透目標30%防禦力。

S1.name: 幽靈出沒
S1.description: 召喚惡靈攻擊兩個敵人，50%機率賦予2回合中毒。

S2.name: 黑暗之雲
S2.description: 召喚黑暗之雲攻擊所有敵人，根據賦予的減益效果數量比例造成傷害。

S3.name: 最後安魂曲
S3.description: 巴爾與賽贊用打擊魔法攻擊所有敵人，85%機率賦予無法恢復和2回合速度降低。

S1.name: 火焰打擊
S1.description: 用火球攻擊敵人，50%機率降低2回合防禦力。攻擊後，35%機率增加20%戰鬥準備度。

S2.name: 鎮定
S2.description: 被攻擊後受到減益效果時，解除所有減益效果並增加施術者2回合攻擊力。每2回合只能發動一次。

S3.name: 餘燼風暴
S3.description: 用火焰爆炸攻擊，使目標無法恢復並各降低1回合防禦力。

S1.name: Eliminating Variables
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by eliminating unnecessary variables. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.

S2.name: Laying the Groundwork
S2.description: Dispels one debuff from an ally before granting increased Attack (Greater) to the caster. When the target has the Target debuff, grants an extra turn to the caster.

S3.name: Eliminating the Target
S3.description: Attacks all enemies by calculating the optimal route, and penetrates Defense by 80%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed. Inflicts Extinction when the enemy is defeated.

S2.name: Supreme Authority
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, increases the caster's Combat Readiness by 30%, and is immune to Combat Readiness reduction effects. When it is not the caster's turn, when an enemy uses a non-attack skill, decreases their Combat Readiness by 30%.

S3.name: Kneel Before Me
S3.description: After dispelling all buffs from all enemies, attacks with dark magic, absorbing 40% of damage dealt as Health.

S1.name: Swift Cut
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with the sword of vengeance, before recovering Health. Amount recovered increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Blade of Vengeance
S2.description: When more than one enemy is alive, at the start of the caster's turn, gain 1 stack of Grudge (max 5 stacks). Additional damage dealt (up to 1,500 per stack, max 7,500) increases proportional to number of Grudge stacks. At the start of the first battle, gains 5 stacks of Grudge.

S3.name: Punishment Strike
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with an aura of vengeance, with a 75% chance to make them unhealable for 2 turns, before granting immunity to the caster for 3 turns.

S1.name: Dragon's Blessing
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, with damage increasing proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Bride's Resolve
S2.description: When an enemy attacks, has a 50% chance to activate Bridal Prayer. Bridal Prayer: Dispels one debuff from the attacked ally and grants a barrier for 3 turns. Gains 10 Souls. When an ally protected by a barrier is attacked, activates Oath of Punishment. Oath of Punishment deals 4000 fixed damage and lasts 3 turns.

S3.name: Overcoming Hardships
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with increased damage. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. Penetrates Defense by 100%.

S1.name: Blazing Bullet
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with bullets of flame. Damage increases proportional to the target's lost Health.

S2.name: Flame Keeper
S2.description: At the start of battle and at the start of the caster's turn, grants the caster increased Attack for 2 turns and increases Effectiveness by 30%. When the caster attacks an enemy with Burn, activates Blaze Bullet.

S3.name: Symphony of Radiance
S3.description: Inflicts Burn on all enemies for 2 turns, before increasing the caster's Combat Readiness by 25%.

S1.name: Let's Go, Kyla!
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with Kyla, recovering Health for all allies. Increased base healing.

S2.name: Elaborate Scheme
S2.description: When an ally except for the caster is attacked, activates Now or Never. Now or Never grants Attack (Greater) to all allies except the caster and increases Combat Readiness of allies by 20%. Grants the caster 50% Combat Readiness.

S3.name: Take the Initiative
S3.description: Attacks the enemy. Grants increased Attack to all allies for 3 turns. When the target is a Hero, ignores damage reduction and damage sharing effects.

S1.name: Bunny Magic
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with bunny magic, with a chance to decrease Combat Readiness.

S2.name: Flow Control
S2.description: When an ally lands a Critical Hit, increases their Combat Readiness by 6%. When the caster's Fighting Spirit is fully charged, activates Flow Control. Flow Control grants Skill Effect Nullifier (1 time) to all allies and increases the caster's Combat Readiness by 30%.

S3.name: Divination
S3.description: Grants Vigor to all allies for 2 turns and increases their Combat Readiness by 30%. Recovers the Health of all allies.

S1.name: Decisive Blow
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a powerful strike.

S2.name: Victorious Return
S2.description: When an ally is attacked, counterattacks and gains 10 Souls. When an enemy is defeated, gains 50% Combat Readiness.

S3.name: Light of Salvation
S3.description: Attacks all enemies. Inflicts Extinction when the enemy is defeated. Faith Rune now increases damage against all elements.

S1.name: Dragon's Breath
S1.description: Attacks all enemies with a dragon's breath, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict decreased Attack for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense. When the caster is inflicted with trauma, activates Unbridled Outburst instead of Dragon's Breath. Unbridled Outburst: Attacks the enemy with a massive blade. Penetrates the target's Defense by 70%.

S2.name: Inner Abyss
S2.description: When the enemy is not an Elite or Boss monster, reduces the effect of Combat Readiness increases granted to the enemy by {{variable}}. When attacked, gains 20 Fighting Spirit and has a 30% chance to counterattack. At the start of the turn, when Fighting Spirit is full, dispels all debuffs from the caster.

S3.name: Frenzied Strike
S3.description: Inflicts trauma on the caster for 3 turns, before attacking all enemies, decreasing Combat Readiness by 50%. Ignores Effect Resistance.

S1.name: Do Not Disturb
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a gun, with a {{variable}} chance to stun for 1 turn. A successful attack always results in a critical hit. When used on the caster's turn, uses It's a Whopper! instead of Do Not Disturb. It's a Whopper!: Attacks all enemies, and gains 1 Focus. A successful attack always results in a critical hit. This skill does not trigger a Dual Attack or counterattack.

S2.name: I’m Still On Vacation!
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, gains 3 Focus. Increases Evasion by 50%, and when Focus is 1 or higher, increases Evasion by an additional 50%. After an ally uses a basic skill, consumes 1 Focus, triggering a Dual Attack, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by {{variable}}.

S3.name: In the Palm of My Hand
S3.description: Attacks the enemy, decreasing Defense for 2 turns, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%. A successful attack always results in a critical hit.

S1.name: Lightning of Judgment
S1.description: Attacks all enemies with lightning, with a 25% chance to stun for 1 turn.

S2.name: Overlord of Death
S2.description: Increases damage suffered from Light elemental enemies by 30%. When an ally is attacked, has a {{variable}} chance to activate Mana Barrier. Mana Barrier can only be activated once every 3 turns. Mana Barrier: Grants a ++barrier++ to all allies for 2 turns, and the caster adopts a ++counterattacking++ stance for 2 turns. Barrier strength increases proportional to the caster’s max Health.

S3.name: The Goal of All Life Is Death
S3.description: Dispels all buffs from the enemy before a {{variable}} chance to inflict death sentence. This skill is unaffected by cooldown increase and decrease effects.

S1.name: No Need for Words
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a bardiche, before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by {{variable}}. A successful attack deals additional damage proportional to the caster's max Health. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Aegis Unfold
S2.description: When an ally suffers a critical hit, decreases damage suffered by {{variable}}. When an ally except for the caster suffers a critical hit, counterattacks with Let's Go, Bicorn!. Let's Go, Bicorn! can only be activated once every 2 turns. When more than one damage reduction effect is granted, only the strongest effect is applied. Let's Go, Bicorn!: Attacks all enemies, dispelling one buff, before ++increasing Speed++ of the caster for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: Rage of Nazarick
S3.description: Fiercely attacks the wicked enemy, with a {{variable}} chance each to make them unable to be buffed and decrease Defense for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.
S3.soulburn_effect: Skill cooldown is decreased by 2 turns.

S1.name: Eradicate
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by battering them, with a {{variable}} chance to decrease Defense for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases effect chance to 100% and ignores Effect Resistance.

S2.name: Noble Blood
S2.description: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 20%. At the start of the turn, has a {{variable}} chance to grant ++Mind's Eye++ to the caster for 1 turn. After using Eradicate, when the caster is granted ++Mind's Eye++, activates Trample as an extra skill. Trample: Attacks the enemy by striking from above, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: Genesis
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with Dragon's Might, dispelling all buffs, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Zephyr
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a fan, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by {{variable}}.
S1.soulburn_effect: Combat Readiness increase effect will be applied to all allies.

S2.name: Forest Blessing
S2.description: Grants ++skill nullifier++ once to all allies and increases Combat Readiness by {{variable}}. Grants an extra turn to the caster.

S3.name: Touch of Hope
S3.description: With Elven magic, dispels two debuffs from an ally except for the caster and grants ++Swiit Attack++.

S1.name: Ritualistic Touch
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with fragments of a shimmering star, with a {{variable}} chance to silence for 1 turn.

S2.name: Guardian of Light
S2.description: Immune to stun, and after every attack suffered by an ally except for the caster, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 8% each. When suffering an attack that targets all allies, has a {{variable}} chance to activate Guardian Angel. Guardian Angel: Dispels one debuff from all allies before granting ++skill nullifier++ once.

S3.name: Judgement of Angels
S3.description: With holy light, dispels two buffs from all enemies before a {{variable}} chance to inflict cannot buff for 2 turns and silence for 1 turn.

S1.name: Atten-Tion!
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by whipping up the sand and has a {{variable}} chance to inflict stun for 1 turn, before recovering Health of all allies proportional to the caster’s max Health.

S2.name: Coastal Discipline
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, if an enemy takes the first turn, grants ++immunity++ to all allies for 3 turns, and if an ally takes the first turn, grants ++increased Effectiveness++ to all allies for 3 turns. After suffering an attack that targets all allies, activates Warming Up. Warming Up (++gains 10 Soul++): Grants ++vigor++ and ++increased Speed++ to all allies for 2 turns.

S3.name: Rapid Rescue
S3.description: Fires a rescue line launcher, resetting skill cooldowns of an ally except for the caster before increasing Combat Readiness by {{variable}}. This skill is unaffected by cooldown increase and decrease effects.

S1.name: Dagger Throw
S1.description: Throws daggers at the enemy, with a 50% chance each to inflict two bleeding effects for 2 turns. A successful attack has a 50% chance to activate Expose as an extra attack. Expose can only be activated once per turn, during the caster's turn. Expose: Attacks the enemy, and recovers Health of the caster. Amount recovered increases proportional to the caster's Attack.
S1.soulburn_effect: Has a 100% chance to activate Expose.

S2.name: Wild Instinct
S2.description: Attack increases by 30%. When attacking, cannot trigger a critical hit. At the end of an enemy's turn, when the target is granted a barrier, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by {{variable}}.

S3.name: A Thrashing In The Prairie
S3.description: Runs up to the enemy to attack. When the enemy is defeated, resets cooldown of this skill. Penetrates the target's Defense by 70% and when the target is granted a ++barrier++, increases damage dealt.

S1.name: Shred
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with sharp claws, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict provoke for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Battle Fever
S2.description: Increases Evasion by 50% and increases Evasion of all allies except for the caster by 20%. When successfully evading, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by {{variable}}.

S3.name: Sudden Assault
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by quickly dashing towards them, inflicting stun for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Slice
S1.description: Attacks with an axe, with a {{variable}} chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.

S2.name: Swift Action
S2.description: When somebody dies, caster is granted ++increased Attack++ for 1 turn and Combat Readiness increases by {{variable}}.

S3.name: Execution
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a powerful ground pound, inflicting silence for 1 turn and decreasing Combat Readiness by 50%, before granting ++increased Evasion++ to the caster for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed. Inflicts 20 Soul Removal on the enemy.

S1.name: Ambush
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by ambushing them. When the caster is granted ++stealth++, increases damage dealt and grants ++increased Speed++ to the caster for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.

S2.name: Cloak and Dagger
S2.description: When the caster does not have a debuff, has a {{variable}} chance each to be granted ++increased Attack++ for 1 turn at the beginning of turn and ++stealth++ for 1 turn at the end of the turn.

S3.name: Murder
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by moving silently. When the enemy is defeated, inflicts silence on all enemies for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.

S1.name: Melody of Damnation
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a punishing melody. When the target has a debuff, increases damage dealt.

S2.name: Disciple of the Stars
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants ++Star's Blessing++ for 1 turn. When the caster is granted ++Star's Blessing++, enemy Heroes cannot counterattack. After an ally except for the caster uses an attack that targets all enemies, activates Worship Me!. Worship Me! (++gains 10 Soul++): Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%.

S3.name: Enraged Star's Retribution
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with the energy of the enraged star, decreasing buff durations by 1 turn before restricting for 2 turns. Grants ++Star's Blessing++ to the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Ghost Haunt
S1.description: Summons an evil spirit to attack two enemies, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict poison for 2 turns.

S2.name: Dark Cloud
S2.description: Attacks all enemies by summoning a cloud of darkness. Damage dealt increases proportional to the number of debuffs inflicted on the target. When an enemy is defeated, resets cooldown of Last Requiem.

S3.name: Last Requiem
S3.description: Baal & Sezan attack all enemies with offensive magic, with a {{variable}} chance each to inflict unhealable and decreased Speed for 2 turns.

S1.name: Are You Ready?!
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a giant shield, with a 45% chance to provoke for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. When used on the caster's turn, Are You Ready?! changes into an attack that targets all enemies. The changed attack does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: Catch 'Em!
S2.description: After being attacked, has a {{variable}} chance to grant ++increased Critical Hit Damage++ to the foremost ally for 1 turn before making them counterattack. When attacked by an enemy inflicted with provoke or redirected provoke, doubles effect chance. Cannot be triggered by extra attacks or counterattacks.

S3.name: Is This It?! Nyahaha!
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a huge explosion, provoking for 1 turn. Grants a ++barrier++ to all allies for 2 turns. Damage dealt and barrier strength increase proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Mana Arrow
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with concentrated mana, before a 35% chance to activate Mana Burst. Effect chance is doubled when the target is silenced. Mana Burst: Attacks all enemies, decreasing Combat Readiness by a random amount between 15% and 50%.

S2.name: High Mage's Might
S2.description: Immune to silence. Reduces the effect of decreased Combat Readiness debuffs inflicted on the caster by {{variable}}.

S3.name: Mana Fundamentals
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with condensed mana, with a {{variable}} chance to decrease Defense and silence for 2 turns.

S1.name: Data Collection
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, and recovers Health of the ally with the lowest Health. When all allies are Earth elemental, recovers Health of all allies instead. Amount recovered increases proportional to the caster's Health.

S2.name: Tool Utilization
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants a ++barrier++ to the caster for 2 turns, and at the end of the turn, grants a ++barrier++ to the ally with the lowest Health for 2 turns. Barrier strength increases proportional to the caster's Health.

S3.name: Research Design
S3.description: Grants ++immunity++ to all allies for 2 turns.

S1.name: Baseless Rumor
S1.description: Attacks the enemy and decreases Combat Readiness by {{variable}}. When the target is inflicted with block, doubles the amount of Combat Readiness decrease.

S2.name: Subterfuge
S2.description: Dispels two debuffs from an ally and increases Combat Readiness by {{variable}}.

S3.name: Nothing Personal, Kid
S3.description: Dispels all buffs from the enemy, before a {{variable}} chance each to inflict bind and block for 2 turns.

S1.name: Punishment
S1.description: Attacks an enemy with a sharp dagger, before recovering Health of the ally with the lowest Health proportional to damage dealt.

S2.name: Divine Punishment

S2.description: Attacks all enemies by infiltrating deep into enemy lines.

S3.name: Promised Glory
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by rushing them down, and grants ++immunity++ to all allies for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's max Health.

S1.name: Quick Fire
S1.description: Rapidly shoots the enemy, with a {{variable}} chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S2.name: Precise Attack
S2.description: Fires a missile at the enemy, and when the enemy is defeated, inflicts extinction. Hit Chance is increased by 15% when using this skill.

S3.name: Limiter Release
S3.description: Releases the limiter, granting ++increased Attack (Greater)++ and ++Critical Hit Chance++ to the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Basic Shot
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by shooting arrows, with a {{variable}} chance to target for 2 turns.

S2.name: Concentrated Fire
S2.description: Fires arrows at the enemy to attack, dispelling one buff. When the caster has a buff, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

S3.name: Shock Arrow
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by shooting lightning arrows, inflicting silence for 2 turns and decreasing Combat Readiness by 100%. Grants a ++barrier++ (proportional to the caster's level) to the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Spiral Cut
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a machete, with a {{variable}} chance to decrease Defense for 1 turn.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases effect chance to 100%, and decreases Defense of the target for 2 turns.

S2.name: Natural Storyteller
S2.description: After an ally uses an attack that targets all enemies, activates Continuous Strike against the enemy with the highest Combat Readiness. Continuous Strike: Attacks the enemy, decreasing Combat Readiness by 20%, and increases Combat Readiness of the ally with the highest Combat Readiness except for the caster by 20%.

S3.name: Narrative Retcon
S3.description: Plants a bomb on all enemies and decreases Speed for 2 turns.

S1.name: Overpower
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict burn for 1 turn. When Merciless Execution is on cooldown, activates Annihilate instead of Overpower. Annihilate: Attacks the enemy, inflicting burn for 1 turn, and at the end of the turn, detonates burn effects inflicted on the target.
S1.soulburn_effect: Inflicts an additional burn effect for 1 turn.

S2.name: Operational Readiness
S2.description: Increases Effectiveness by {{variable}}. When attacking, cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow. At the start of the first battle, grants ++explosives++ to the ally in the back row except for the caster.

S3.name: Merciless Execution
S3.description: Attacks all enemies, with a {{variable}} chance to burn for 2 turns, and at the end of the turn, detonates burn effects and bombs inflicted on the target.

S1.name: Lunging Slash
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, with a {{variable}} chance to decrease Defense for 1 turn. When used on the caster's turn, activate Dazzling Slash as an extra attack if the caster is buffed. Dazzling Slash: Swiftly attacks the enemy, inflicting restrict for 1 turn.

S2.name: Assault Coordination
S2.description: After attacking four times, grants a ++barrier++ to all allies for 2 turns and increases Combat Readiness by 15%. Barrier strength increases proportional to the target's max Health.

S3.name: Battle Cry
S3.description: Raises the morale of all allies, granting ++immunity++ for 2 turns and decreasing debuff durations by 1 turn.
S3.soulburn_effect: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn.

S1.name: Oopsie!
S1.description: Accidentally spills bread to attack the enemy, and triggers a Dual Attack from a random ally, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by {{variable}}.
S1.soulburn_effect: Combat Readiness increase effect will be applied to all allies.

S2.name: No Bullying!
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, gains {{variable}} Fighting Spirit, and when the foremost ally except for the caster is an Earth elemental Hero, gains 40 additional Fighting Spirit, before granting ++Special Friendship++ to the target. After being attacked, gains 20 Fighting Spirit and when Fighting Spirit is full, consumes all to dispel all debuffs from the caster before activating Help! Help!: Attacks all enemies, and grants an extra turn to the caster. A successful attack deals additional damage equivalent to 15% of max Health of the caster and the foremost ally except for the caster.

S3.name: Snack Time!
S3.description: Stops fighting and takes a break, dispelling all debuffs from all allies and increasing Combat Readiness by {{variable}}. Stops fighting and takes a break, dispelling all debuffs from all allies and granting ++continuous healing++ for 2 turns before increasing Combat Readiness by {{variable}}.

S1.name: Vampirism
S1.description: Claws the enemy, before absorbing some of the damage as Health.

S2.name: Vengeful Strike
S2.description: Attacks the enemy, decreasing Combat Readiness by {{variable}}.

S3.name: Spiteful Annihilation
S3.description: Attacks the enemy, dispelling all buffs and making them unable to be buffed for 2 turns, before ++increasing Attack++ and ++Defense++ of the caster for 2 turns.
S3.soulburn_effect: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn.

S1.name: Lightning Kicks
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with kicks and dispels one buff.

S2.name: Advent of the Sura
S2.description: After an ally uses a non-attack skill, activates Swallow Kick on the enemy with the highest Defense. Swallow Kick: Attacks the enemy by leaping forward, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%. Penetrates the target’s Defense by 50%. When the caster is granted ++vigor++, grants an extra turn.

S3.name: Argent Flash
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a water scooter, and increases Combat Readiness of the ally in the back row by 50%. Grants ++vigor++ to the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Mirror Fragment
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a mirror, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict a random debuff for 1 turn. When Mirror of the Abyss is on cooldown, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

S2.name: Consuming Grasp
S2.description: After inflicting rupture on all enemies for 2 turns, attacks all enemies and has a {{variable}} chance to inflict restrict for 2 turns. Grants ++stealth++ and a ++barrier++ (proportional to the Level) to the caster for 2 turns.

S3.name: Mirror of the Abyss
S3.description: Traps all enemies in a timeless space beyond the mirror, dispelling two buffs before inflicting a random debuff for 1 turn. Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%.

S1.name: Divine Punishment
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with divine lightning and has a {{variable}} chance to inflict fear for 1 turn, before recovering Health of all allies proportional to the target's max Health.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases effect chance to 100%, and attacks all enemies. This attack does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: Scales of Equity
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants ++offering++ to the foremost ally. When the ally granted ++offering++ dies, recovers Health of all allies by 50%. When Combat Readiness of an enemy increases during battle, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by {{variable}} of the amount of Combat Readiness increased. This effect will not be applied to the Combat Readiness increase effect triggered by the same skill.

S3.name: The Caress of Mercy
S3.description: With the Goddess's authority, dispels all debuffs from all allies before increasing Combat Readiness by {{variable}}. Consumes 20% of the current Health of the ally granted ++offering++, granting ++abundance++ to all other allies for 2 turns.

S1.name: Horizontal Slash
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, and absorbs some of the damage dealt as Health. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Surpressed Desire
S2.description: Increases Evasion of all allies by 30%, and when an ally except for the caster evades, counterattacks. After attacking, when Fighting Spirit is full, consumes all, granting ++Demon Blade Unleashed++ to the caster for 1 turn before activating Blade Art: Bewitching Blossom. Blade Art: Bewitching Blossom: Consumes all Health to attack all enemies, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's lost Health.

S3.name: Rouge Aroma
S3.description: Dispels all buffs from all enemies before inflicting beguile and inflicting decreased Hit Chance for 2 turns. Ignores Effect Resistance of targets with less max Health than the caster.

S1.name: Sacred Blade
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword blast. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Chains of Binding
S2.description: After inflicting seal and collapse on the enemy for 2 turns, attacks the enemy. A critical hit will grant an extra turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: Goddess's Judgement
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with divinity and penetrates the target's Defense. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. Damage dealt increases with fewer enemies. At the start of the first battle, grants ++Sacred Covenant++ for 5 turns.

S1.name: Hide in the Shadows
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by swinging a sword, and has a {{variable}} chance to grant ++stealth++ to the caster for 1 turn.

S2.name: Aegis of Time
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants ++increased Critical Hit Resistance++ to all allies for 1 turn. Upon dying, revives with {{variable}} Health.

S3.name: Once-in-a-Life Research
S3.description: (Before Enhancement) Dispels all debuffs from all allies except for the caster and recovers Health before granting ++barrier++ for 2 turns. Amount recovered and barrier strength increase proportional to the caster's max Health. Grants ++solution++ to the caster and decreases skill cooldowns by 2 turns. (After Enhancement) Grants time reversal to all allies except for the caster and grants a ++barrier++ proportional to the caster's max Health to all allies except for the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Ordinary Offensive Magic
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with magic, and grants ++immunity++ to the caster for 1 turn. When it is the caster's turn, activates Vollzanbel as an extra attack. Vollznabell (gain 1 Soul): Attacks all enemies with flame magic. Damage dealt increases proportional to the amount of the enemy's lost Health.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases damage dealt of Ordinary Offensive Magic.

S2.name: The Highest Form of Magic
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants 40% resource increase to all allies. During battle, when Soul is 4 or higher, grants ++Defensive Magic++. After being attacked, increases Combat Readiness of all allies by {{variable}}

S3.name: Judradjim
S3.description: After granting ++increased Attack++ to the caster for 3 turns, attacks all enemies with lightning magic, dispelling all buffs. Penetrates the target's Defense by 50%.

S1.name: The Spell to Kill Demons
S1.description: After granting ++increased Attack++ to the caster for 1 turn, attacks the enemy with magic. When Focus is 3 or higher, decreases skill cooldowns by 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.
S1.soulburn_effect: Attacks all enemies. This attack does not trigger a Dual Attack or counterattack.

S2.name: Exceptional Magical Talent
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, gains 3 Focus. Increases Speed by 15% and Evasion by 20% for each Focus. When successfully evading, consumes 1 Focus and decreases skill cooldowns by 1 turn.

S3.name: The Spell to Kill Demons - Release
S3.description: After granting ++increased Attack++ to the caster for 1 turn, attacks the enemy with The Spell to Kill Demons. Penetrates the enemy's Defense by 70%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed. Begins the first battle with a full skill cooldown count.

S1.name: Vanguard's Strike
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with an axe and inflicts provoke for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Master's Lessons
S2.description: When an ally is attacked, gains 10 Fighting Spirit, and when Fighting Spirit is full, activates Warrior's Strike on the attacker. Warrior's Strike (consumes 100 Fighting Spirit): Attacks the enemy consecutively, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50% before resetting cooldown of Lightning Strike. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: Lightning Strike
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by slamming down with an axe. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. Damage dealt increases every time this skill is used, stacking up to 3 times.

S1.name: Spirit Burst
S1.description: Attacks two enemies with a burst and has a {{variable}} chance to dispel one buff.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases effect chance to 100% and ignores Effect Resistance.

S2.name: Guidance of Nature
S2.description: At the start of an ally's extra turn, gains 2 Focus and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 30%. After using a skill, when Focus is full, activates Wings of Liberation. Wings of Liberation(consumes 5 Focus): Attacks all enemies by unleashing a spirit bird. Increases Hit Chance by 50% when using this skill, and is unaffected by elemental disadvantage.

S3.name: Blossoming Hope
S3.description: By kindling the light of hope, grants ++invincibility++ to all allies for 1 turn .

S1.name: This'll Sting!
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a scalpel, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict two bleeding effects for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bleeding effects inflicted on the target,
S1.soulburn_effect: Grants an extra attack with the same skill.

S2.name: There, It'll Feel Better
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, increases Attack proportional to max Health. At the start of an ally's turn, dispels one debuff from the target and recovers Health proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: It's Time to Be Reborn!
S3.description: Dispels all debuffs from an ally except for the caster before fully recovering Health. Grants ++superhumanization++ to the target for 3 turns and increases Combat Readiness by 50%. This skill is unaffected by cooldown increase and decrease effects.

S1.name: Repel
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a chain axe, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict decreased Defense for 1 turn. When the caster is granted ++rage++, activates Eradication as an extra attack. Eradication: Attacks the enemy, inflicting bleed for 2 turns, and at the end of the turn, detonates bleed effects inflicted on the target. Ignores Effect Resistance.

S2.name: Abyss Observer
S2.description: At the start of battle and at the end of the turn, grants ++stealth++ to the caster for 1 turn. At the end of someone's turn, when an enemy is inflicted with provoke or redirected provoke, grants ++rage++ to the caster for 2 turns and increases Combat Readiness by {{variable}}.

S3.name: Unexpected Accident
S3.description: Attacks all enemies by staging an accident, inflicting three bleeding effects for 1 turn. When the target is inflicted with provoke or redirected provoke, extends duration of bleed inflicted on the target by 1 turn. When the caster is granted ++rage++, ignores Effect Resistance.

S1.name: Crimson Claws
S1.description: After inflicting rupture on the enemy for 1 turn, attacks the enemy. A successful attack always results in a critical hit. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. When the caster is granted ++immortality++, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

S2.name: Noias's Guidance
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants ++immortality++ for 1 turn. When granted ++immortality++, increases Effect Resistance by 200%. When someone uses a Soulburn, dispels all debuffs from the caster before activating Dark Moon. Dark Moon: Dispels two buffs from all enemies, before granting ++immortality++ to the caster for 3 turns and increases Combat Readiness by {{variable}}.

S3.name: Endless Darkness
S3.description: After inflicting seal on all enemies for 1 turn, attacks them and decreases Combat Readiness by 30%. A successful attack always results in a critical hit. When the caster is granted ++immortality++, ignores Effect Resistance. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.
